title: Senior AI Engineer

title: Operations Lead
description:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.
 The Role: CoMind is building deep-tech medical technology against demanding timelines, and we're looking for an Operations Lead to own how the company delivers and how it runs day to day. This is a senior role reporting to the GM, focused on making sure the business delivers what it has committed to, on time and done well, and on building the operational backbone a fast-growing company needs.
 You'll keep work moving across every team, own the company's operating rhythm and its key initiatives, and take on the enabling functions that keep the business running and protected. It's a role for someone at their best building process, systems and structure, and being judged on whether it all delivers.
 You'll join at a pivotal stage for the company, with real ownership over how it runs and the mandate to make delivery relentless. If you're at your best when you're close to the action, deep in the detail, and getting things over the line, we'd love to talk.
   At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week in the office, plus a flexible work-from-home day. This role is based in our London (Kings Cross) office.
 Responsibilities: Keep work moving across teams, so delivery doesn't drift. Create clear plans, clear owners, visible progress, and raise blockers early
 Own the company's operating rhythm: Company objectives, KPIs and risk review cadence
 Take company-wide initiatives and land them, from plan to live to keeping them running
 Own the enabling functions that keep the business running and protected as it scales
 Bring structure including scoping new needs and coming back with a clear recommendation

You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on how we find, engage, and win the specialist and leadership talent this space demands; bringing structured market intelligence, sharp judgment on ambiguous and high-stakes searches, and the credibility to shape hiring strategy at the most senior tables in the business.
